xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4432: CI test-failure relay never fires: red test shards stall PRs with no route back to the agent

plan.title: CI test-failure relay never fires: red test shards stall PRs with no route back to the agent
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The PAN-3965 CI test-failure relay has never fired. Root cause (verified in planning, see PRD): src/dashboard/server/routes/webhooks.ts forks webhook dispatch with Effect.forkChild and returns the response; in Effect 4 the child is interrupted before it starts, so no GitHub webhook handler has run since the Effect 4 upgrade. Evidence: 116k '[webhook] Received' log lines and zero handler-body log lines; zero project.ci_suite_observed events against 22k check_suite deliveries; a scratch reproduction against the repo's effect 4.0.0-beta.73. The only other relay caller (polling reconciliation) was deleted in PAN-3917. Red test shards therefore stall PRs with idle agents.
narratives.Proposal: Run dispatch as a detached promise with a logging catch (the fix). Then, per the issue's acceptance: resolve check_run and failing check_suite payloads with an empty pull_requests array from the head branch, accepted only at the same head SHA; log every relay decision not to deliver; raise needs-you when the plain CI FAILED message is not delivered; document it in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md and docs/EXTERNAL-EVENT-STREAM.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No polling or Deacon backstop for webhooks missed while the dashboard is down (follow-up PAN-4439)
- No change to the relay's attempt budget, escalation rule, or verification feedback door
- No metering of the relay's raw execFile('gh') calls through runGh
- No disabling or gating of the webhook handlers the fix revives (review auto-start, postMergeLifecycle/finishStrike, CI observation, resource refresh)
- No commit-to-PR lookup (GET /repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/pulls); fork PRs are not supported by the fallback
- No needs-you for a red check on a feature PR that has no work-agent row
- No new journal entry types or state files; observability is log lines only
- No raise of any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Treat the Effect.forkChild interruption in routes/webhooks.ts as the root cause and fix it first; the issue's two suspects are not the primary cause
autoDecisions.rationale: A scratch reproduction with the repo's effect 4.0.0-beta.73 shows the forked dispatch never starts, and live evidence (zero handler log lines across 116k webhooks, zero project.ci_suite_observed events against 22k check_suite deliveries) confirms no handler runs

It is the fire-and-forget idiom already used in dashboard routes (routes/hooks.ts, routes/resources/snapshot.ts), and it removes the watcher fiber that would otherwise die the same way and hide errors

autoDecisions.summary: Ship the empty pull_requests fallback anyway, resolving by head branch and confirming by head SHA
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance criteria require it; Overdeck PRs come from feature/strike/bypass branches in the same repo where head_branch is set, so a commits/{sha}/pulls lookup is unnecessary

autoDecisions.summary: Fix dispatch for every event type and do not gate the revived handlers
autoDecisions.rationale: The bug is in the shared dispatcher; the revived behaviors (review auto-start, post-merge lifecycle, CI observation) are documented features with existing coalescing and idempotency guards

autoDecisions.summary: Generic-path needs-you only when a work agent exists and the message was not delivered
autoDecisions.rationale: A red check on an operator's own feature branch with no agent is not an operator alert; the test-gate path already raises needs-you through the verification feedback door

autoDecisions.summary: No polling backstop in this issue; record it as a follow-up
autoDecisions.rationale: A backstop has cross-process idempotency questions (the Deacon runs the relay in a child process with its own memo) and is not in the issue's acceptance criteria

autoDecisions.summary: The live canary (project.ci_suite_observed after the next main push) is a post-merge check, not an xBRIEF AC
autoDecisions.rationale: Work, review and test roles run before merge against the currently deployed dashboard and cannot observe the fixed build

items.title: Run GitHub webhook dispatch as a detached promise that logs failures

expected_outputs: webhooks.test.ts passes including the two new PAN-4432 tests

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/pan-4432.md). ROOT CAUSE of PAN-4432: in src/dashboard/server/routes/webhooks.ts (anchor 'Dispatch handlers asynchronously so DB work', lines 169-181) replace the two Effect.forkChild calls (dispatch fiber + watcher fiber) with `void dispatchWebhook(eventType, payload).catch((err: unknown) => { console.error(`[webhook] Dispatch failed for ${eventType}:`, err); });`. In Effect 4 a forkChild child is interrupted when the handler returns, before it starts, so no webhook handler has ever run. Do NOT use Effect.forkDetach and do NOT keep the watcher fiber. Change the import to `import { Effect, Option } from 'effect';` (drop Exit, Fiber; leave pre-existing unused Option). Add one header sentence: handlers run detached after the 200 response; a failed dispatch logs `[webhook] Dispatch failed`. Add two tests to describe('runWebhookHandler') in tests/unit/dashboard/routes/webhooks.test.ts: (1) a valid signed check_run body calls the handleCheckRun mock once with the parsed payload after `await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r))`; (2) a rejecting handleCheckRun mock yields a 200 response and console.error('[webhook] Dispatch failed for check_run:', err). No fake timers needed.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In src/lib/webhook-handlers.ts: extend WebhookPayload.check_run with `head_sha?: string` and `check_suite?: { head_branch?: string | null; head_sha?: string }`. Add module-private `resolvePullRequestsForHead(listed, headBranch, headSha, label)` exactly as in the PRD: return listed when non-empty; else issueIdFromBranch(headBranch) (log '[webhook] <label>: no pull_requests and no issue branch' and return [] when absent); lazily import fetchIssuePullRequest from './overdeck/pull-requests.js' and call getPrFacts(issueId, { fetchGitHubPr: fetchIssuePullRequest }); accept only facts.open && facts.number != null && facts.headSha === headSha, returning [{ number, head: { ref: facts.headBranch ?? headBranch, sha: headSha } }]; log and return [] otherwise; catch → console.warn and []. In handleCheckRun replace line 203 `if (!run.pull_requests || run.pull_requests.length === 0) return;` with: compute actionable = conclusion in FAILING_CHECK_CONCLUSIONS or (SUCCESS and isCiTestCheckName(run.name)); call the resolver only when listed is empty, actionable, and not advisory; return when the result is empty; loop over the result (loop body unchanged). Tests in describe('handleCheckRun') of tests/unit/lib/webhook-handlers.test.ts, add vi.mock for '../../../src/lib/overdeck/pull-requests.js' ({ fetchIssuePullRequest: vi.fn() }); four tests as listed in PRD WI-2.
